title: Aakar Template Descriptor v1
description: What a parametric template publishes about itself: parameters with ranges, anchors for text and motifs, handles for morph nodes, constraints and allowed materials. Served by the geometry service and cached by the API.

environment.description: Viewer backdrop: an environment id from the reference data (experience.v1.json environments, packages/design-tokens/experiences.json; GET /api/environments).

hardware.description: Bought-in parts this template's pockets, holes and slots are cut for; authoritative over the family default.

min_feature_mm.description: Smallest printable stroke or detail (0.8 mm for a 0.4 mm nozzle); text and silhouette checks use it.

handle.description: Exposed as a draggable morph handle in the viewer.

group.description: UI grouping, e.g. Size, Shape, Details.

anchor.description: A named place where content may land: a surface (text, motif, relief) or a volume (a customer's own 3D form). size_mm/bounds_mm are the 3D analogue of a print area; bleed_mm the safe margin inside it.

size_mm.description: Printable width and height of a surface anchor.

bleed_mm.description: Content stays inside size_mm minus twice the bleed.

bounds_mm.description: Width, depth and height of a volume anchor; content is scaled to fit.

accepts.description: Feature types allowed on this anchor; defaults to the template's features_supported.

max_relief_mm.description: At least 0.4 mm, the shallowest text depth, so every accepted feature can fit. Cap for relief_image.relief_mm (emboss and deboss) and emboss depth on this anchor. relief_image in lithophane mode is exempt: the plate itself is the relief and the template's lithophane hook owns its thickness range.
